about: HID reports (transports §1): count(u16), first(u16), the stream's count bytes, zero padding - after the report ID when the descriptor declares one. room: each report's length after the report ID (12 bytes of the stream here). A reader starts as one that has just opened the transport.

pack.name: an 18-, a 14-, a length 0 and a 7-byte frame (41 bytes): firsts 0, 6, 8, none - the report holding only the last frame's tail has none

read.name: every report: every message, the length 0 frame read past
the second report missing: its first does not match where the reader's frame ends (6 against 8), the two frames it cut are lost, the reading goes on from 8
opened at the second report: read from its first (6)
opened at the last report: no first, nothing read
a count over what the report holds: dropped, broken till the next first
a first not below count: dropped, broken till the next first
